introduction: Welcome to the Plains of Life. Follow the signs to learn the basics before entering the world.
orientation: Follow the trail north, east, east, north, east, and east. Use look sign at each tutorial sign.
The first two signs offer armor and bless when examined with look sign. These are optional aids, not recorded journal achievements.
Practice attributes, score, wear all, equipment, skills, innates, and help commands as the signs and rooms explain.
Meet the paladin and ask paladin racewars or ask paladin racewar. New arrivals need this conversation before entering the Life Stream.
At the end of the trail, use enter stream to travel to Ailvio. Sword possession does not open the stream; the tutorial state does.

contacts.name: a solemn paladin
contacts.description: The paladin explains racewar and offers a blessed sword to a tagged new arrival. Repeating the lesson does not award another sword. Then enter stream at the end of the trail. The journal does not yet record these scripted milestones.
